notes.summary: classNames.historyBackdrop sets a class on the backdrop of the full-screen chat drawer; the drawer states (data-drawer="true", hidden, role="dialog") are documented as stable.
notes.howTo: Optional: classNames={{ historyBackdrop: 'my-backdrop' }}. The shipped backdrop color comes from a (0,2,0) rule, so a single class does not override it: use .my-backdrop.my-backdrop or [data-element="history-backdrop"].my-backdrop after styles.css, or unstyled; existing CSS on [data-element="history-backdrop"] keeps working. Select the drawer with [data-element="history"][data-drawer], the open one with :not([hidden]); aria-expanded on [data-action="history"] holds for the built-in toggle (a renderButton sets its own). A renderButton that opens a tooltip on focus shows it when focus returns to the chats toggle after the drawer closes; open it on :focus-visible or hover only. See placing-the-assistant.md, Replacing shell parts.

notes.summary: A message showing the Markdown loading skeleton switches to its raw text when react-markdown has not arrived within markdown.loadingTimeoutMs (default 4000 ms from the start of the import), and to Markdown if it still arrives.
notes.howTo: Nothing to do. Set markdown={{ loadingTimeoutMs }} to change the limit: a number of milliseconds counted from the start of the import (the provider's preload at mount, the first message, or an own preloadMarkdown() at app start: the clock starts at every start of the import, so the limit may have passed before the chat appears, and its messages then show the raw text directly); false, Infinity or more than 2^31 - 1 keep the skeleton until react-markdown loads or fails (as in 0.24); 0 shows no skeleton at all (the raw text while loading, as before 0.24.0); a negative number, NaN or a non-number means the default. A bubble that first renders after the limit shows the raw text directly. The raw text is [data-component="markdown"] with the source as text; the copy button is unchanged; nothing is announced. Tests with fake timers that keep react-markdown pending longer than 4 s now see the raw text instead of the skeleton.

notes.summary: Behavior change: a picked mention is sent with its canonical label. Ordinary labels, ids and types stay byte-identical; hidden characters, { } <! -->, line breaks, edge whitespace and over 120 code points change the label; a type or id with hostile characters is sent without a marker.
notes.howTo: Nothing to do for the new default. Label changes: NFC; edge whitespace trimmed; control and line-separator runs one space (NBSP, U+3000, space runs stay); { } <! --> --!> become ｛ ｝ ‹! --› --!›; format characters, default ignorables, private use, noncharacters, U+2800 and lone surrogates removed, except one ZWJ between emoji, one ZWJ/ZWNJ between letters of a joining script, the England/Scotland/Wales flag tags, one VS15/VS16 after an emoji (digits, # and * only in a keycap), one IVS after Han, one Mongolian FVS; over 120 code points cut at a grapheme boundary with …. A mention whose type or id has control, format, invisible, private-use, unassigned or noncharacters, }, {{, <!, --> or --!> keeps its typed token without a marker, so the model loses the id; the chat warns once per type (dev). Entry points: legacy mentions config, completion items, addActiveMention, addMention/insertMention/setValue with app-built mentions, stored drafts and queue items. Spaces, <, >, {, capitals stay valid in types and ids, : in ids only (a type with : is refused). An app that needs the old format sets mentions: { serialize: { labels: 'raw' } }; maxLabelLength (8-120) cuts shorter; raw skips validation, the one-pass replacement applies in both modes. See docs/chat-interactions.md, Mention markers.

notes.summary: New in glirastes/contracts: the view context contract (what the user looks at, declared by the app): entry types and schemas, sanitizeViewContext for untrusted input and resolveViewContextPolicy for the coming viewContext server option. Nothing uses it yet.
notes.howTo: Nothing to do. sanitizeViewContext(input, { declaredTypes, factsSchemas, policy }) keeps up to 8 entries (a record of a declared entity type, a list view selection, or both) and drops invalid entries or fields with content-free reason counts (each stops at VIEW_CONTEXT_LIMITS.maxDropCount, 1,000,000: exact up to that many dropped, a lower bound only beyond); facts are kept only against a schema with safeParse (Zod or the runtime's JSON schema validator). The chat handler option, the browser registry and the model block follow in later releases.

notes.summary: Since 0.24 the voice button draws its own icon instead of the words mic, stop and retry. An app that hid those words with CSS and drew its own icon (::before/::after, content:) now shows two icons.
notes.howTo: Remove the app's own icon and the CSS that hid the text, or style the shipped icon through the data attributes instead: the button is [data-component="voice-input-addon"] (VoiceInputButton: [data-component="voice-input-button"]) with data-state idle, connecting, recording or failed; its icon is svg[data-icon="mic" | "stop" | "busy"], the retry button [data-action="retry-recording"] with svg[data-icon="retry"]. To keep only an own icon, hide the shipped one ([data-component="voice-input-addon"] svg[data-icon] { display: none }) and keep drawing yours. No hidden text is needed for screen readers: the buttons carry a localized aria-label.
